# Roost2D model context

Roost2D is an Apache-2.0 TypeScript ESM monorepo containing 13 lockstep public packages. Start with README.md, docs/architecture.md, docs/packages.md, and the target package README.

Critical boundaries:
- contracts: serialized schemas and validation
- core: deterministic runtime/scenes; no renderer
- pixi: PixiJS v8 adapter
- rig2d: renderer-neutral rigs/GSAP animation
- assets: explicit-host manifest loading and SHA-256 integrity
- tooling: Node-only; never import from browser packages
- chikn-rigs: Apache-2.0 metadata only; no image rights, image corpus, or required asset-pack dependency

Roost2D does not include, license, or sublicense Chikn/Roostr/FarmLand visual content. The separate asset repository documents Chikn's community non-commercial boundary.

Source is packages/*/src and apps/*/src. Generated dist/docs output and tarballs are not source. All @roost2d dependencies must use the same exact version.

Primary commands:
npm ci
npm run build
npm run check
npm test
npm run release:verify

Integration guides:
- docs/getting-started.md
- docs/chikn-assets.md
- apps/showcase

Never publish without explicit release authorization. RCs use npm tag next; stable versions use latest.
